decisions.why: all examples (Active Micro Plus, Active Trainer, Gait Trainer, Basic Basic) are patient handling slings
lifting hangers and hand-control rests are hoist accessories (spreader bars/controls) used with hoists and standing aids
Gh3/Gh3Plus ceiling lift units and rail systems are ceiling hoist equipment
Gh3/Gh3Plus lifting modules and rails are ceiling hoist equipment
mobile transfer platforms and active/mobile lifters (Gtp1, Gl52, Gls52) are floor-based hoists
